# Sheet-Pan Lemon Chicken and Veg

Serves about 4. About 40 minutes.

## Ingredients
- Chicken (the frozen chicken from home), fully thawed in the fridge
- About 800g potatoes, cut into chunks
- 3 carrots, cut into batons
- 1 red onion, cut into wedges
- 1 zucchini and 1 capsicum, chopped (buy extra if the pasta bake uses the first lot)
- 1 broccoli, cut into florets
- 1 lemon (zest and juice)
- 3 garlic cloves, crushed
- Dried mixed herbs, olive oil, salt, pepper (from home)

## Method
1. Thaw the chicken fully. Frozen chicken will not roast properly.
2. Heat the oven to 200C. Roast the potatoes and carrots with oil, salt and pepper for 15 minutes.
3. Toss the chicken with oil, lemon zest and juice, garlic, mixed herbs and salt. Nestle it among the potatoes and carrots.
4. Add the red onion, zucchini and capsicum. Roast another 20-25 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through (no pink, juices run clear).
5. Add the broccoli for the last 10 minutes.

## Notes
- Adapted from sheet-pan chicken and veg recipes (Natasha's Kitchen, Tasty, Cooked by Julie). Quantities and timings are my own adaptation.
